value.title: Fleet follow-ups: flakes, test timing and verdict notes

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Nine tasks, one coder. F27 first (CI trust), then F28 and F26; AC4 to AC6 wait for #131, #129 and #132 to merge; cost, docs and states last.

value.title: F27: the Rust flakes at their roots
value.success: claude_heal_scripts: EPIPE on a payload the script never needed is not a failure; claude_inbound: the daemon installs its SIGINT handler before printing readiness (production race); pane_observer: teardown asserts no server is left, not kill-server's status; control_mode (found on main, run 42154126103): the test window is named so automatic-rename cannot move it.

value.title: F27: the watchdog smoke's private-daemon teardown
value.success: The fixture's daemon stop waits longer than the daemon's own 5 s drain (SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT) before SIGKILL; other children keep the 3 s bound.
value.notes: Run 42147635271: the daemon printed shutting down, then was SIGKILLed 3 s after SIGINT (status null). TS proof is CI-only (C25).

value.title: F27: the reaper tests under load
value.success: The reaper tests named by pm-001 pass 50 in a row under load, fixed at the root.
value.notes: Reaper tests dropped (pm-001 20:21): the 13 reaper:: tests passed 50 runs in a row niced (load 29 to 51) and in three full daemon-lib runs under taskpolicy -b (load 25 to 49); no flake to fix.
value.note: Dropped (pm-001 20:21): the 13 reaper:: tests passed 50 runs in a row niced and three full daemon-lib runs under taskpolicy -b; no flake to fix.

value.title: F28: one test-only time scale for real-child budgets
value.success: pij_testkit::time::scaled and harness/driver/time-scale.ts read PIJ_TEST_TIME_SCALE (default 1; below 1 or not a number refuses). Real-child budgets use it (claude_heal, claude_inbound, control_mode, registration's real-ps tests through a cfg(test)-only observation deadline, the governance fixture). Production constants unchanged. AGENTS.md (resource cost item 5) and the shared-build header carry the nice-only rule.

value.title: F26: the skill check passes and runs in the gate
value.success: pij-skill-check.sh exits 0: markers plan 175 and 186 reworded are updated, the ones they reversed are retired with the reason in a comment, and routes/peer.md is back under its 150-line budget (reflowed, no text change). A pij-skill sensor runs it in harness checks, and just self-check runs it.

value.title: #131 N002: recorded_by from the newest record
value.success: After #131 merges: the delivery card's recorded_by comes from the same row as its recorded_at.

value.title: #129 digest scope
value.success: After #129 merges: the PA digest reads queued rows for the PA's projects only, without bodies; the prime falls back to all projects.

value.title: #132 late admission
value.success: After #132 merges: a bound-ended memory turn awaits its owned admission's settle after the held action and records delivered-late, queued or refused.

value.title: Cost, docs and states
value.success: Cost receipts per bp-0007; difficulties.md records F26, F27, F28 resolved; ddocs-check passes; PR body has a Delivers line.

value.title: Ledger items owned by 209 (F30-F51)
value.success: Each item in ac-0009 is fixed with a test, or measured (F44), or moved with a reason (F32 to #138).

value.success: Each of F35, F36, F37 and F38 has its fix and one test.
